user.title: Add a lock with a latch
user.description: Creates one HomeKit accessory for a lock. You pair it in the Home app with the code HA shows afterwards.

data_description.entity_id: The Home Assistant lock (for example a Nuki).
data_description.name: Name of the HomeKit accessory and of its lock.
data_description.latch_name: Name of the second lock, the momentary one.
data_description.latch_action: What moving the latch does: lock.open unlatches (Nuki), lock.unlock just unlocks.
data_description.reset_seconds: Seconds until the latch is back to secured.
data_description.expose_lock: Turn off for a Nuki Opener: then only the latch is shown and the ring-to-open state stays out of HomeKit.

error.no_free_port: No free port left between 21100 and 21199.

abort.already_configured: This lock already has an accessory.
